ns2:course.label: Physical Geology
ns2:course.description: Introduces Earth phenomena and processes. Includes minerals and rocks, continental drift, plate tectonics, rock deformation, igneous and sedimentary processes, geologic time, landscape evolution, internal structure and composition of the earth, groundwater, seismology and earthquakes, and formation of natural resources. Emphasizes the chemical and physical aspects of the Earth, and the basis for geological inference. Field trip and field trip fee required. Intended for science and science-oriented students. Credit is not given for both GEOL 107 and GEOL 100, GEOL 101 or GEOL 103.
